classification: Lynx previously rendered the When value as a content-sized bare text node, collapsing the third structural column and shifting Status left by roughly 189px. It now renders a native view trigger with the Web 290px column allocation, 28px control, border, radius, label, and chevron while reusing the existing edit state. The strict gate projects Web's empty Status cell from its header column but still requires real conflict status geometry. Table SSIM improves from 0.823224 to 0.902126 and the When/Status region from 0.688307 to 0.897124 with byte-identical Web pixels.
